# Place-name fixtures (FL-987)

A small, hand-written sample in the layout of the GeoNames files the place-name pack is built from
(`bin/build-place-names-pack.mjs`): `alternateNamesV2.txt`, `cities500.txt`, `admin1CodesASCII.txt`,
`admin2Codes.txt` and `countryInfo.txt`. The geonameIds of Munich, Bavaria, Upper Bavaria, Germany, Tokyo and
Japan are the real ones; several names and every other value are made up to exercise the builder's rules.
Columns are separated by tabs. GeoNames data is © GeoNames, CC BY 4.0.
